concepts.label: Position
concepts.note: EM, UP: measured with rulers / frame coordinates; HEP: the spectrum of the position operator (quantum observable).

concepts.label: Electron-positron field / electron sector
concepts.note: EM: the Dirac field operator as a state-layer node; HEP: the Fock sector that the field creates (antiparticles share the sector).

concepts.label: Planck's constant
concepts.note: ROLE FLIP: a measured constant (observable) in both readers; an axiom (deformation scale) in the nonclassicality network.

concepts.label: Lagrangian / action principle
concepts.note: EM: the action principle (gauge shift by a total derivative); HEP: the particle Lagrangian, rewritten at Step 2 into the Klein-Gordon/Dirac equations.

concepts.label: Photon
concepts.note: ROLE FLIP: EM detects the photon one at a time (observable); UP treats the photon (E = hf, p = hbar k) as a state; HEP has the photon Fock sector (state).

concepts.label: Fine-structure constant
concepts.note: alpha = e^2 / 4 pi.

concepts.label: Canonical commutator / Poisson-to-commutator lift
concepts.note: EM: [x, p] = i hbar sharing the algebraic properties of the Poisson bracket; GPT: the Moyal deformation of the observable algebra.

concepts.label: Operator algebra and Born rule
concepts.note: Observables as self-adjoint operators with the Born rule; EM keeps two nodes, HEP one.

concepts.label: Hilbert-space state / wave function
concepts.note: The quantum state as a ray; HEP's one-particle Hilbert space is the carrier that the quantum-information state clusters refine (cross-edges).

concepts.label: Creation and annihilation operators / quantum field
concepts.note: EM: each mode quantized as an oscillator; HEP: the field operator on Fock space as a framework node.

concepts.label: Schrodinger equation / unitary evolution
concepts.note: EM, UP: the equation of motion; HEP: the one-parameter unitary group it generates; GPT: the process cluster of unitary dynamics (model layer in all four).

concepts.label: QED interaction (Lagrangian / vertex)
concepts.note: EM: the full QED Lagrangian; HEP: its interaction term, the vertex -e psi-bar gamma psi A.

concepts.label: Cross sections
concepts.note: Scattering rates per unit flux.

concepts.label: Wigner-negative states
concepts.note: CV states with a negative Wigner function.

concepts.label: Lamb shift
concepts.note: 2S_1/2 - 2P_1/2 splitting.

concepts.label: Anomalous magnetic moment of the electron
Poisson bracket / symplectic structure
concepts.note: EM: dF/dt = {F, H}; GPT: the symplectic/Poisson axiom that generates classical probability (the genesis column).

concepts.label: Bell / CHSH inequalities
concepts.note: Bell functionals as detectors.

concepts.label: Bell nonlocality
concepts.note: ROLE FLIP: an effect (violation) in GPT; the resource (nonlocal boxes) in QRT.

concepts.label: Wigner-negativity estimators
concepts.note: Displaced-parity and other negativity estimators.

concepts.label: Covariant (symmetric) operations
concepts.note: G-covariant channels; GPT's node is the U(1) case.

concepts.label: Measurement incompatibility
concepts.note: ROLE FLIP: an effect in GPT; a device resource (incompatible POVM sets) in the state layer of QRT.

concepts.label: Entangled states
concepts.note: Outside SEP.

concepts.label: Gibbs (thermal) state
concepts.note: QRT keeps two nodes (the distinguished shared state and the free set of athermality); UP's Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution is the classical one-particle marginal of the canonical Gibbs state.

concepts.label: Stabilizer subtheory
concepts.note: GPT separates the odd-d (epistricted) and qubit subtheories; QRT has one model node (Gottesman-Knill).

concepts.label: Kochen-Specker contextuality
concepts.note: ROLE FLIP: effects (state-independent and state-dependent KS) in GPT; the resource (contextual behaviors) in QRT.

concepts.label: Entanglement witnesses
concepts.note: Witness operators (and PPT).

concepts.label: Bound (PPT) entangled states
concepts.note: PPT entangled states.

concepts.label: Stabilizer / Clifford operations
concepts.note: GPT's node is the Clifford group (the unitary part); QRT's node is the full stabilizer-operation class. Identified at the level of the free class of magic.

concepts.label: Gaussian subtheory (CV)
concepts.note: Gaussian quantum mechanics as a model.

concepts.label: EPR steering
concepts.note: ROLE FLIP: an effect in GPT; the resource (steerable assemblages) in QRT.

concepts.label: State injection / universal computation
concepts.note: ROLE FLIP as for di_tasks.

concepts.label: Magic (non-stabilizer) states
concepts.note: Outside the stabilizer polytope.

concepts.label: Discordant states
concepts.note: Nonzero quantum discord.

concepts.label: Classical-classical (zero-discord) states
concepts.note: The non-convex free set of discord.

concepts.label: Second law(s) of thermodynamics
concepts.note: ROLE FLIP: a model-layer law in the textbook; in the quantum branches the second laws are observable-layer tests (a task in GPT; the F_alpha monotone family in QRT) on state conversion.

concepts.label: Stabilizer states
concepts.note: STAB, the free set of magic.

concepts.label: Separable states
concepts.note: SEP, the free set of entanglement.

concepts.label: Basis-coherent states
concepts.note: Non-diagonal in the fixed basis.

concepts.label: Device-independent tasks
concepts.note: ROLE FLIP: a task (observable layer) in GPT; the resource-utilizing operation class (model layer) in QRT.

concepts.label: Symmetric (TTS / energy-diagonal) states
concepts.note: QRT's free set of asymmetry for a general group G; GPT's node is the U(1) (time-translation) case.

concepts.label: Local-broadcasting test
concepts.note: The same test.

concepts.label: LOCC / non-entangling operations
concepts.note: Free operations of entanglement.

concepts.label: Parity-oblivious multiplexing / RAC advantage
concepts.note: ROLE FLIP as for di_tasks.

concepts.note: ROLE FLIP as for di_tasks.

concepts.label: Athermal states
concepts.note: Outside {gamma}.

concepts.label: Asymmetric (energy-coherent) states
concepts.note: QRT's resource states of asymmetry for general G; GPT's node is the U(1) case.

concepts.label: Incoherent operations
concepts.note: The MIO...SIO lattice; GPT's node names incoherent / dephasing-covariant ops.

concepts.label: Magic witnesses
concepts.note: Stabilizer witnesses.

concepts.label: Coherence monotones
concepts.note: C_r, C_f, l1 and event-graph tests.

concepts.label: Metrology / clocks
concepts.note: ROLE FLIP: postselected metrology as a task in GPT; metrology and clocks as asymmetry-utilizing operations in QRT.

concepts.label: Thermal operations
concepts.note: Energy-conserving unitaries with Gibbs ancillas.

concepts.label: Steering inequalities / LHS tests
concepts.note: LHS-SDP tests.

concepts.label: Discrimination advantage
concepts.note: GPT: state discrimination; QRT: channel discrimination (the universal task of robustness). Both tasks in the observable layer.

concepts.note: NC inequalities / simplex-embedding LP.
